amount.description: the signed movement of the line

currency.description: the transaction currency of the amounts

document_date.description: the date of the supplier document, distinct from posting

document_number.description: the source supplier document (bill / credit memo) number

document_type.description: the BC ledger document type (invoice / credit memo / payment / application)

due_date.description: the date the payable falls due

financial_period.description: the accounting period the entry falls in

gl_account.description: the ledger account the line posts to

is_open.description: whether the entry is still open

legal_entity.description: the company whose books the entry belongs to

occurred_at.description: the posting date the entry was booked on

pmt_discount_date.description: the settlement-discount date, if the supplier offers one

project.description: the job the payable is attributed to, when the source supplies one

purchaser_code.description: the BC buyer/purchaser code on the entry

remaining.description: the running balance still outstanding on the entry

source_system.description: the system the entry was read from

vendor.description: the supplier the payable is owed to
